# testing_mixed_request_and_response_type (Resource)

MixedRequestAndResponseType Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_mixed_request_and_response_type" "my_mixedrequestandresponsetype" {
  float_with_update_request_float32 = 5.46
  integer_with_update_request_int32 = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `float_with_update_request_float32` (Number)
- `integer_with_update_request_int32` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_mixed_request_and_response_type.my_testing_mixed_request_and_response_type
  id = "random-id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_mixed_request_and_response_type.my_testing_mixed_request_and_response_type "random-id"
```
